Given the nature of the exposed data and the legal requirements of GDPR and CCPA, notification is not only advisable but legally mandated.  Failure to disclose risks severe reputational damage, potential regulatory fines, and future legal action from affected customers.  While the timing of the IPO is a factor, our ethical and legal obligations to our customers must take precedence. We must prioritize transparency and customer trust to mitigate the long-term consequences of this breach.
